$comment: What `npm run generate:api-reference` (docs/scripts/generate-api-reference.mjs) generates in this repository: the route-table field reference from app-runtime's schema, the Gateway's own HTTP routes, and each listed app's route table under the name and mount a stack gives it. An explicit, stable list, so freshness checks never depend on the apps a developer has installed. Apps MDK ships live in their own repositories and generate their references there with the same @tetherto/mdk-app-runtime functions.
